prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one new finished landscape 16:9 Chinese cultivation-game planting page, with a visual style closely MATCHING THE ATTACHED REAL PROJECT SCREENSHOTS. The user rejected a decorative green-and-gold fantasy parchment UI as unlike their game. This must look like another functional screen inside THIS specific understated ink-wash game.

Reference image roles:
1. Project main screen: reference ONLY for off-white fibrous paper, grey-green dry-ink borders, small muted ink accents, regular readable Chinese Kaiti/slab lettering, muted painted surfaces and handmade paper/ink atmosphere. Do NOT copy its world-map composition, mountains, character list or bottom navigation.
2. Project library: reference ONLY for quiet matte desaturated grey-blue, grey-brown timber, ivory paper, restrained sage selection and the regular thin dark Chinese game type. Do NOT copy bookshelves, furniture, library, building or cabinet composition.
Generate a NEW planting page. Do not remix the screenshots' gameplay objects.

VISUAL STYLE, essential:
- Mostly light warm-grey ivory and cool grey-green. Dark ink lettering like the references' ordinary gameplay font, NOT oversized brush-calligraphy headings.
- Simple complete rectangular paper panels, very fine irregular dry-ink edging. A few flat dull grey-brown material edges. Small plain rectangular paper buttons and muted sage active fill.
- No saturated dark teal/green title banner, no bamboo ornament, no gold, no bevelled ornate corners, no fantasy mobile-game chrome, no glossy stones or decorative white glints.
- Main field art in the project's flat hand-painted ink-and-muted-color style: broad matte warm grey-brown soil washes, faint few brush-drawn earth seams, sparse subdued ground details. NOT realistic granular soil, NOT bright green lawn, NOT dense tiny pebbles. Artwork and paper should feel drawn with the same hand as the screenshots.
- Finished usable game UI with clean high-contrast Chinese and restrained details. Not a marketing board, not a photo, not isometric.

PAGE REQUIREMENT: ONE field, ONE page. Exactly one continuous rectangular planting ground. No multi-field map, no subplots or internal tile grid, no player character. Straight vertical orthographic overhead. Every supplied field begins with the same baseline; differences develop from player adding materials and doing actual modifications.

STRUCTURE:
Top narrow light paper heading, dark regular text “瑶圃峰 · 一号田”. To the right a simple paper button “返回田地”. A pale grey-blue ink-wash margin around the full interface, no scenic illustration taking space.

Upper left approx 55% of screen:
Compact title “田地” with small text “未定植”. Selector “目标灵草：月露苔”. Two small view tabs “当前” (sage selected) and “改造预览”.
Below, a single large continuous flat soil bed from straight overhead, outlined by a low subtle earthen boundary only. No stone border, tree, pond, shading structure, rocks or any applied modifications. No crops planted yet. Keep the soil a calm greige watercolor surface rather than a realistic farming texture.
One concise status line underneath: “原有土层：普通土层” and “已加入材料：暂无”.

Upper right approx 41% of screen:
Title “环境与灵草需求”. Clear four-column comparison with thin subtle row separators, no heavy spreadsheet cells. Columns exactly:
“条件” | “当前” | “需求” | “差距”
Rows exactly:
“温度” | “偏暖” | “凉润” | “偏暖”
“灵力” | “偏低” | “充足” | “不足”
“水分” | “湿润” | “湿润” | “满足”
“光照” | “直射” | “遮阴” | “过强”
“土层” | “普通土层” | “阴湿岩面” | “不符”
Sage check symbol on satisfied water and muted brick crosses on unmet rows; all with accompanying words.
Below table, clearly readable short message:
“温度偏暖、灵力不足、光照过强。”
“当前土层也不满足需求。”
This is an UNPLANTED field, do not show a stopped or damaged plant.

Lower paper workspace across full width, approximately 26% of the image:
Title “田地改造”. Plain navigation tabs “添加材料” (active), “控温”, “水分”, “光照”, “聚灵”.
IMPORTANT semantic correction: “添加材料” means adding actual other items into the existing ground. DO NOT use the term 基质 anywhere in this screen. DO NOT show preset soil types, substrate packages, “腐殖/岩质/遗骸” category tabs, a soil-upgrade tree, or a soil-replacement-before-after system. The original ground stays; items are added to it. Future remains could be actual inputs for specific plants but no remains type or recipe is defined here.
The selected tab contains three simple horizontal groups:
1. Label “已加入材料” with “暂无”.
2. Label “准备加入” with a simple empty outlined paper item slot showing a modest plus sign, and a plain button “选择材料”. No fake inventory, no invented named materials.
3. Label “影响预览” with text “选择材料后查看环境变化。” and “未满足的条件仍会保留。”
At the lower right use restrained disabled grey-outline controls “预览” and “加入材料”, visually disabled while no material is selected. This is the legitimate initial selection state, not a loading skeleton.
Do not invent actual item effects or show a rock material magically satisfying the soil requirement.

Keep typography modest, crisp, aligned and comfortably readable at desktop size. All Chinese text as specified above. No fictional numeric thresholds, costs, timers, inventories or success scores. No developer notes or “example” tags in the game screen. No watermark. This must visibly depart from ornate generic fantasy UI and closely resemble the actual attached project's paper/ink, matte grey-blue, grey-brown, subdued sage gameplay screens.
